receipt_commit_rule: The immutable review/qualification head is the commit that creates this receipt. Its sole immediate parent must equal pre_receipt_publication_subject.commit. Verify branch readback, this receipt blob, parent, and tree before relying on the publication binding.
reason_for_exclusion: Avoid circular self-binding while retaining an exact externally verifiable publication chain: core bytes -> freeze descriptor -> pre-receipt commit/tree -> receipt commit.
review_rule: Blind review must bind this exact receipt commit/head and may not reuse R5 approval/failure results as R6 qualification.
